cases.note: four strokes, corners on both sides
a short stroke: the corner is half a unit up
a stroke going down: the corner is to the right
corners outside the range of the input

cases.name: gen3
cases.note: endpoints one unit apart with corners on half units
separated zero-length strokes span the full x range but have zero height
positive translated strokes give half-unit width and height without including the origin
reversing an oblique stroke puts its second corner on the opposite side
negative and positive half-unit corner extrema must not be truncated toward zero
seeded small random strokes end with an isolated zero-length point that expands the frame
seeded mixed directions have unequal half-unit dimensions enlarged by corners on both axes
interior point strokes come first and the last four strokes set all frame extrema
